notes: Roster sourced from Wikipedia 'List of current members of the Rajya Sabha' (live revision fetched 2026-09-25), which already reflects the Mar-Jun 2026 biennial elections and subsequent by-elections/nominations (e.g. Andhra Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Gujarat, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Odisha, Punjab, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Arunachal Pradesh members with 2026 term-start dates; 12th nominated member Harivansh Narayan Singh's new nominated term 2026-04-10 to 2032-04-09). One elected seat is currently vacant: West Bengal seat 16, vacant since 2026-07-16 per Wikipedia (marked vacant:true, no holder) - this reconciles the page's separate party-strength table (NDA 152 + INDIA 63 + Others 29 = 244) against the 245 total named/vacant seats in the roster (233 elected incl. 1 vacant + 12 nominated). The Wikipedia article's intro states RS membership is 'limited to 250' (238 elected + 12 nominated) under the Fourth Schedule, but the actual allocated/tracked total used throughout this dataset and its source roster is 245 (233 elected + 12 nominated) - this is the long-standing conventional total; I did NOT independently verify against the Fourth Schedule text why the constitutional ceiling (250) exceeds the allocated total (245) - flagging as a gap rather than guessing. Treat in-rajya-sabha.seats (245) as currently-allocated seats and stats.sanctionedSeats (250) as the constitutional ceiling only. GAP: Leader of the Opposition and Leader of the House 'since' dates and the Chairman/Deputy Chairman dates were verified via WebFetch summaries of Wikipedia pages (not the raw Wikipedia parse API, which was rate-limited for large parts of this run from shared outbound IP contention with sibling research agents) - cross-checked against the nominated-members roster table where possible (Harivansh Narayan Singh) but not independently re-verified against a second primary source (PIB / rajyasabha.nic.in) due to tool/time budget; recommend a follow-up spot-check against rajyasabha.nic.in's official 'Who's Who'. GAP: party abbreviations are taken verbatim from the Wikipedia state-list 'Keys' legend/table (e.g. JD(U), YSRCP, TDP) and not independently normalized against a canonical party-ID list (none exists yet in this project) - downstream consumers may want a party entity registry. GAP: did not add nameHi (Hindi names) for entities/positions - not reliably available from the English Wikipedia sources used. GAP: exact constituency-level detail beyond state name (e.g. specific electoral college composition) not included; state assemblies are referenced by st-<code>-assembly only, not itemised by MLA. Party-wise strength block (NDA/INDIA/Others incl. all group members and floor leaders) captured under in-rajya-sabha.stats.

entities.name: Rajya Sabha
entities.description: The upper house of India's bicameral Parliament. Members are indirectly elected by the elected members of State and Union Territory Legislative Assemblies (single transferable vote), plus 12 nominated by the President for contributions to art, literature, science and social service. It is a permanent body, not subject to dissolution, with one-third of members retiring every two years.

entities.name: Rajya Sabha Secretariat
entities.description: Permanent administrative and procedural staff of the Rajya Sabha, under the overall direction and control of the Chairman, headed by the Secretary-General. Provides secretarial, research, legislative-drafting and committee support to the House.

holder.name: C. P. Radhakrishnan
holder.notes: Ex officio Chairman by virtue of being Vice-President of India (Article 64). See in-pos-vice-president for the underlying office/election.

positions.title: Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha

holder.name: Harivansh Narayan Singh
holder.notes: 13th Deputy Chairman; elected by RS members under Article 89(1). First elected 2018-08-08, re-elected 2020-09-14, re-elected unopposed for a third term on 2026-04-17 (concurrent with his new nominated-member term that began 2026-04-10, term end 2032-04-09).

positions.title: Leader of the House, Rajya Sabha

holder.name: Jagat Prakash Nadda
holder.notes: 28th Leader of the House; a Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister to lead Government business in the Rajya Sabha (convention, not a constitutional office). Also Union Minister of Health & Family Welfare and Chemicals & Fertilisers; see in-pos-minister-health-and-family-welfare (council-of-ministers segment) for that portfolio.

positions.title: Leader of the Opposition, Rajya Sabha

holder.name: Mallikarjun Kharge
holder.notes: 14th Leader of the Opposition in the Rajya Sabha; recognised under the Salary and Allowances of Leaders of Opposition in Parliament Act, 1977, as leader of the largest opposition party (INC, 30 seats).

holder.name: Pramod Chandra Mody
holder.notes: 13th Secretary-General of the Rajya Sabha; a permanent official (not an MP), holds the rank of a Union Government Secretary, appointed by the Chairman.

positions.title: Member of Parliament, Rajya Sabha
positions.notes: Vacant since 2026-07-16. Term (if filled by a fresh election) would run to 2032-04-02.
